purpose: Transfer poles and zeros with explicit input and output ports

oracle.derivation: Compute numerator and denominator roots of the voltage transfer: highpass sRC/(1+sRC), lowpass 1/(1+sRC), notch (1+s^2LC)/(1+sRC+s^2LC). Roots are in rad/s.

known_gaps: explicit PZ ports and transfer zeros are not yet exposed by the dispatcher
